name: Travel
tagline: Sequences a multi-leg trip into a critical path, books nothing
description: For journeys with too many moving parts: flights, stays, ground transfers and the paperwork stringing them together. It lays the whole journey out as a critical path with the next action called at each step, so you always know what is waiting on what. It plans only , every reservation and payment stays with you.
author: stevenvillarino
